comment: What tools/image/smoke.mjs needs that is particular to this repo: the bin (its log topic), a command that makes one request, the exit code of a network error, the mock's answer to that request (by path, under --base-url http://mock:8080; the client adds /app/chart_data), and a string the printed answer contains. The answer is the live index of the hourly grid load, recorded on 2026-11-19 and cut to its last four weeks.
